subject: barrel roll mad
author: theelliyworkshop
body:
best place for barrel rolls and best car,it has to be at the quarry with the new hot rod.

but there are many places all over paradise.

take a step back and think about it a barrel roll is like a flatspin only spins differnt right.

so just before you hit that ramp,you turn left or right holding the ebrake and hold it untill you land right.

so what i say is this, do the same with a split ramp and you start to barrel roll. 

if the split ramp is on the right then just before you hit the ramp turn left and ebrake, and see what you come up with.

up to 9 rolls in to quarry ,  7 rolls off read lane , 7 rolls  out side lawrence tunnel
